mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.5% in a month signals tightening monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate investment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where the FEDFUNDS rate increases by more than 0.5% in a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden increase in the unemployment rate by more than 0.5% in a month indicates a weakening labor market, which is a leading indicator of economic slowdown and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where the UNRATE increases by more than 0.5% in a month.

mechanism_narrative: A consistent increase in housing starts over three consecutive months signals a strengthening demand in the housing sector, which is a positive indicator for the broader economy and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where HOUST increases for three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production by more than 1% in a month indicates a contraction in supply, which can lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investors react to the weakening economic indicator.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where INDPRO declines by more than 1% in a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained low inflation environment, indicated by CPIAUCSL remaining below 2% for three consecutive months, signals a stable monetary policy that supports positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where CPIAUCSL remains below 2% for three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls by more than 200,000 in a month, combined with a decrease in the unemployment rate, signals a strengthening labor market, which is a positive indicator for the economy and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where PAYEMS increases by more than 200,000 and UNRATE decreases.

mechanism_narrative: A consistent increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) over three consecutive months, coupled with a stable or decreasing unemployment rate (UNRATE), signals robust consumer demand and a healthy labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS increases for 3 consecutive months and UNRATE stable or decreases
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where RSAFS increases for three consecutive months and UNRATE is stable or decreases.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate above 5% for three consecutive months signals a restrictive monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate investment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where FEDFUNDS remains above 5% for three consecutive months.
